Classification: Bloodline (Infernalist)

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali}, sometimes called the Shaitan, are as old as the first dark rites, born when an ancient tribe of humans made a pact with dark forces called the Lords (Ba'al). A Cainite is said to have touched surviving members of this tribe with his blood, founding the tainted line. The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali} see existence as a struggle between two great cosmic powers and value only whether one can participate in that struggle; human souls, not Cainites, are of value to the powers they serve. The bloodline has splintered into rival sects worshipping different dark forces, and was greatly weakened by a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.Ei698TPekL0hRbUS]{Salubri} crusade to exterminate infernalists and a subsequent @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} holy war (which the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali} answered by cursing the Assamites with an irrational thirst for Cainite blood). Baali are now actively distrusted, officially banned from many domains, and generally destroyed on sight if their true clan is known.

Disciplines: Daimoinon, Obfuscate, Presence

Advantage: All Baali begin play with one Ability Trait of Occult and one Influence Trait of Occult. A Baali may ask her sire for aid, though nothing is given without expectation of return.

Disadvantage: Baali suffer twice the normal damage from true Faith and holy relics, and are especially vulnerable to religious symbols and verses (Qur'anic recitation, crosses, Stars of David, or other symbols of True Faith), which can drive them back.

Organization: Fractured into competing infernalist sects that often turn their accumulated influence against each other rather than uniting; childer report up a chain of sires back toward the bloodline's infernal masters, joining their sire's cult upon Embrace via a brutal rite involving a pit of corpses.

Suggested Viae: Sin; a small minority follows the Road of Kings.
